paragraphs: Yuchasin cites him from Tractate Soferim, but Hyman says he is absent from the current Tractate Soferim text.[^1]

notes.text: The absence is Hyman’s observation about his text, not a modern corpus search or exhaustive absence claim. Yuchasin is retained as cited title without adding an author; מס׳ סופרים is read as Tractate Soferim, following supplied סופרים against older machine סיפרים. No named edition is independently checked. The personal title remains R'.
